crossRefs.note: God sent me before you to preserve for you a remnant in the earth, and to save you alive by a great deliverance.
The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening; and he drank from the brook.
to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.
Yahweh will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.
he will dwell on high. His place of defense will be the fortress of rocks. His bread will be supplied. His waters will…
For though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines; the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no…
none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.
I will ransom them from the power of Sheol. I will redeem them from death! Death, where are your plagues? Sheol, where…
Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will…
You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren’t troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not…

translations.web: In famine he will redeem you from death; in war, from the power of the sword.
translations.bsb: In famine He will redeem you from death, and in battle from the stroke of the sword.
translations.kjv: In famine he shall redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword.
translations.asv: In famine he will redeem thee from death; And in war from the power of the sword.
